content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 03 years Diploma in Civil Engineering from Government recognized Institute; Indian University Degree in Civil Engineering; AMIE Section (A&B) India Age limit: Maximum 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: SC 43, ST-1 43, ST-2 43, RBA 43, ALC/IB 43, EWS 43, OBC 43, Physically Challenged Person 42 Other conditions: Candidate must be a Domicile of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir

content_sections.text: Candidates whose qualification is other than that prescribed are not eligible. Candidates using certificates in formats other than the prescribed one for reservation will be rejected.

content_sections.text: Matriculation Certificate for Date of Birth Valid Domicile Certificate Category Certificate in prescribed format Educational/Technical Qualification Certificates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JKSSB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online through the official website www.jkssb.nic.in. Upload live photograph, signature, category certificate and qualification/experience certificates. Pay the application fee online through Net Banking, Credit or Debit cards. Apply on or before 29 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Only one online application for the post of same item number is allowed to be submitted by the candidate
